snippet.title: Catsuhi and Eva - Full VN
snippet.description:
Natsuhi wakes up with cat ears. Eva's here to help.

An 8,415 words evanatsu visual novel by me. It is very comedic and also extremely suggestive. Available now on itch.io.
https://gfiascos.itch.io/catsuhi-and-eva

If, for whatever reason, the links don't work, it is also here in google drive. One for pc (Windows, Linux), & one for Mac. I have no way of testing the Mac version, but I assume it should work properly for you. Remember to extract the folder after download.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1O37dEK4J4aUBqLVi8IGykxLRgLJSBcz3?usp=drive_link

Here is a google doc that has the entire script so it's easier to copy & paste the text into translators while playing if English is not your first language, or if anyone wants it for another reason. There is also a notepad version of this in the folder.
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1f2RPMjIllU5zuMiiZK4gASaO1wmmhj99o8E4-90SIL8/edit?tab=t.0

Thank you for reading ❤️ This took me almost two months and was really annoying to code at times lol 😭. I made a LOT of custom sprites, many of which I didn’t use, but I want to give permission here that anyone is welcome to use them for anything they might want to. You don’t necessarily need to give me credit, but I would appreciate it if you do 🙏😊❤️ I hope you enjoyed, and perhaps I’ll make another evanatsu VN sometime in the future, now that I have experience and know how 🧡💜
